articles.title: World Leaders Urge Stronger Action at COP31 Climate Talks
articles.description: At the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, UN Secretary-General António Guterres urged countries to accelerate climate action, reduce fossil fuel dependence and increase support for vulnerable nations.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine Report Progress in Abu Dhabi Peace Talks
articles.description: US-mediated negotiations between Russia and Ukraine produced some progress and an agreement on a major prisoner exchange, although significant disagreements remain.

articles.title: Ukraine Captures First Indonesian Prisoner of War
articles.description: Reports from Ukraine describe the capture of an Indonesian national amid concerns about recruitment of foreign nationals into Russia's war effort.

articles.title: Gaza Faces Further Humanitarian Challenges Amid Regional Tensions
articles.description: New reports describe continuing violence and humanitarian concerns across Gaza and the wider Middle East, including casualties from strikes and gunfire.
